title: Chicken and orzo bake
summary: Chicken and orzo bake is a mediterranean dinner built around skinless chicken thigh fillets and orzo pasta, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Chicken and orzo bake into even pieces and toss orzo pasta with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of orzo pasta while you season skinless chicken thigh fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle skinless chicken thigh fillets and chopped tomatoes among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Chicken and orzo bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Chicken and orzo bake into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the orzo, simmered in salted water until tender.
